ticker_news.title: Cisco's AI Infrastructure Is Finally Winning Over Hyperscalers
ticker_news.description: Cisco is gaining momentum in AI infrastructure, booking $1.3 billion in AI orders from hyperscalers in Q1 and expecting over $3 billion in AI revenue this fiscal year, signaling a strong turnaround in its AI business strategy.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Green

ticker_news.title: Monolithic Power Surges in 2025—Time to Buy or Hold?
ticker_news.description: Monolithic Power Systems experienced a strong recovery in 2025, delivering a 62% total return despite early-year challenges. The company demonstrated resilience across multiple market segments and shows promising long-term growth potential, particularly in enterprise data and NVIDIA infrastructure.
ticker_news.author: Leo Miller

ticker_news.title: 3 Things Tech Investors Should Know About the World's Largest Chipmaker
ticker_news.description: Taiwan Semiconductor (TSMC) dominates the global chip manufacturing market with a 70% market share, producing advanced chips for major tech companies like Apple and Nvidia. The company is expanding internationally, investing $165 billion in U.S. production facilities and experiencing significant revenue growth driven by cutting-edge 3nm and 5nm chip technologies.
ticker_news.author: Lyle Daly

ticker_news.title: Meet the Best "Magnificent Seven" and "Ten Titans" Growth Stock for Value Investors to Buy in 2026
ticker_news.description: The article highlights Microsoft as the best value stock among the 'Magnificent Seven' and 'Ten Titans', praising its diversified business model, strong balance sheet, and ability to invest in AI without compromising financial health.
ticker_news.author: Daniel Foelber

ticker_news.title: Kranot Hishtalmut Loads Up on CheckPoint Software Technologies Stock With Nearly 87,000 Shares
ticker_news.description: Israeli investment firm Kranot Hishtalmut acquired 86,599 shares of CheckPoint Software Technologies, valued at approximately $17.87 million, representing 1.2% of its portfolio assets in a new strategic investment in the cybersecurity sector.
ticker_news.author: Will Healy
